trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: Earn the other 54 trophies and this one follows: finish the story, reach 100% completion, then sweep up whatever is left — it pops the moment the 54th lands.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Finish the opening mission, Gone Fishing. This is the story's first mission, so it comes to you as you play — and it stays hidden on PlayStation until it pops.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 1. A story trophy that lands on its own — but before the chapter ends, do the balcony meditation for Positive Mental Attitude (see that trophy): after Chapter 1 it is gone, and there is no mission replay.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 2. A story trophy; once Jason and Lucia are both playable in this chapter, most of the list opens up.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 3. A story trophy that pops as the campaign rolls on.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 4. A story trophy. The Chapter 4 optional mission 'That's Where The Money Is…' also opens the eight large bank vaults — save the last vaults until then.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Finish the final mission. Keep a manual save from just before it: with no mission replay and no new game plus, that save is your only way back to the finale.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Finish the mission Breakfast Run. A story-mission trophy that pops when the mission ends.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Finish the mission The Cartel Heist. A story-mission trophy that pops when the mission ends.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Finish the mission Child's Play. A story-mission trophy that pops when the mission ends.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Finish the mission Headliners. A story-mission trophy that pops when the mission ends.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Finish the mission VCIA Takedown. A story-mission trophy that pops when the mission ends.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Finish the mission Operation Savage Glory. A story-mission trophy that pops when the mission ends.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion. In-game, open Progress, then Stats, then 100% Completion for the checklist — most activities only need a portion (300 of 397 stunts, 70 of 80 challenges, 15 of 18 card sets), not everything. The hardest trophy on the list; a platinum run takes around 200 hours.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Finish 250 stunts. There are 397 stunts in total, so you need just over half — and 300 for 100% completion, so keep going past 250 instead of stopping.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the nine activity types once. Sample one of each early; the trophy only asks you to try them, not to master any.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. Gold every range challenge; 100% completion demands the same 42 of 42, so this is one of the few activities it wants in full.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every one of the 14 locations. One win at each; the 42 Drone Time Trials at the same locations are a separate 100% completion requirement.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Twenty distinct wins; 100% completion wants 30 of 40 unique races, so this is the shorter half of that grind.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Out-fish Cal — fishing is one of the activities the story introduces, so look for it once it opens up.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Finish an arcade game. Play any one arcade game through to the end.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish the final mission for Andy. Complete Andy's mission strand; its last mission pops the trophy.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Finish the final mission for Kenton. Complete Kenton's mission strand; its last mission pops the trophy.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish the final mission for Billy. Complete Billy's mission strand; its last mission pops the trophy.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Finish 8 mission strands for strangers across Leonida. Eight qualifying Strangers & Freaks strands; look for strangers while you explore the state, not just in Vice City.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Finish the final mission for Randy. Complete Randy's mission strand; its last mission pops the trophy.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish the final mission for Tyrone. Complete Tyrone's mission strand; its last mission pops the trophy.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every spot across Leonida — 18 spots. THE missable one: after the mission Down to Earth, find Lucia at Jason's house in the morning; when she mentions meditating, follow her to the balcony and accept. Do it before leaving Chapter 1 — it is gone after that chapter, and there is no mission replay. The other spots can wait; 15 of 18 count toward 100% completion.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Take Bret's hunting work and bring down the unique animal he names; his Target Deck objectives also feed the 100% completion list.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Finish 3 Collectible Card sets. Three full sets; 100% completion wants 15 of 18 sets, so card hunting goes on well past this trophy.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: WAiNK It at 100 locations. Scan with the WAiNK app at 100 locations — scan vehicles and landmarks as you meet them from the start and the count builds on its own.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Finish 50 Challenges. Fifty of the game's challenges; 100% completion wants 70 of 80, so this is the first two-thirds — skip the hardest ten and come back only if you need them.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat. Build a four-star wanted level while your partner is with you, then shake the cops — break line of sight and stay out of the search area until it clears.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level. Three shops in a row with your partner alongside, keeping the wanted level alive the whole run — don't let it clear between shops, and move to the next shop fast.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Scan new vehicles with the WAiNK app as you find them; 100% completion wants 200 of 277 base models, so keep scanning past 100.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Trigger Combat Focus with at least five enemies in range and drop all five before it ends — pick a firefight with a group, not a lone enemy.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA. Steal a departing passenger aircraft from Vice City International Airport and take off in it.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Kinda hot in these Rhinos. Steal a Rhino military tank and put it to use in combat.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Get in and out without tripping detection — plan the approach, stay out of sight lines, and leave before anyone raises the alarm.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 Bank Vaults and escape. Five vaults, and get away clean each time; 100% completion wants all eight, unlocked by the Chapter 4 optional mission 'That's Where The Money Is…', so hold the last vaults until then.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an Armored Truck and escape. Hit an armored truck and get away with the take.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida. Cover all 52 areas and uncover the whole map — it fills in as you travel, so this mostly finishes itself if you explore widely instead of fast-travelling everywhere.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang. One illegal operation for each of the nine gangs; 100% completion wants all 39 gang operations, so this trophy is the first pass over that list.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Have a cocktail somewhere with a view over Ocean Beach; the exact trigger is still being pinned down by launch-day guides, so try the beachfront bars and check back.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. Break out of a vehicle showroom through the glass in the classic style; the exact method is still unconfirmed by launch-day guides.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley. Steal the three key valuables at the Kolt & Associates bowling alley and get out.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: A partnership with mass appeal. Max out the Strength stat for both Jason and Lucia.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Choices made (for better or worse). Rack up 500 actions that feed your Criminal Profile — the profile grows as you make choices and act in the world, so this builds across a normal playthrough rather than needing a dedicated grind.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Second time's the charm. The unlock method is still unconfirmed by launch-day guides — the name points at succeeding on a second attempt at something. Don't chase it; it will surface as guides confirm it.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: What the hell just happened? A hidden trophy whose unlock is still unconfirmed — it reads like a strange world encounter, so keep playing, explore odd places, and watch for strange events.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by. Knock someone down with a melee attack from a moving vehicle; the precise method is still being pinned down by launch-day guides.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Fence marked bills through your contacts until $250,000 is laundered; the same $250,000 counts for 100% completion, so it pays twice.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Spend $100,000 in shops across the game — weapons, clothes, food and gear all count.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase all garage properties. Buy all eight purchasable garages — they also give you somewhere to keep the vehicles you discover for Whip It Good.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Register ten vehicles through the Scooter Bros app — any vehicles you drive count once registered.
